info.description: Regenerate Redis cache's access keys. This operation requires write permission to the cache resource.
info.title: RedisManagementClient

requests.description: Lists all of the available REST API operations of the Microsoft.Cache provider.
requests.name: GET /providers/Microsoft.Cache/operations
requests.note: Replace {{REDISMANAGEMENTCLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Checks that the redis cache name is valid and is not already in use.
requests.name: POST /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/providers/Microsoft.Cache/CheckNameAvailability
requests.note: Replace {{REDISMANAGEMENTCLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets all Redis caches in the specified subscription.
requests.name: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/providers/Microsoft.Cache/Redis
requests.note: Replace {{REDISMANAGEMENTCLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists all Redis caches in a resource group.
requests.name: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.Cache/Redis
requests.note: Replace {{REDISMANAGEMENTCLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets all firewall rules in the specified redis cache.
requests.name: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.Cache/Redis/{cacheName}/firewallRules
requests.note: Replace {{REDISMANAGEMENTCLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes a single firewall rule in a specified redis cache.
requests.name: DELETE /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.Cache/Redis/{cacheName}/firewallRules/{ruleName}
requests.note: Replace {{REDISMANAGEMENTCLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets a single firewall rule in a specified redis cache.
requests.name: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.Cache/Redis/{cacheName}/firewallRules/{ruleName}
requests.note: Replace {{REDISMANAGEMENTCLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Create or update a redis cache firewall rule
requests.name: PUT /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.Cache/Redis/{cacheName}/firewallRules/{ruleName}
requests.note: Replace {{REDISMANAGEMENTCLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets all patch schedules in the specified redis cache (there is only one).

requests.note: Replace {{REDISMANAGEMENTCLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.note: Replace {{REDISMANAGEMENTCLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
